title: Aura
wikitext:
[[File:Aura screenshot.png|right|thumb|A Marauder with five auras: Determination, Grace, Haste, Hatred and Purity of Elements.]] An '''aura''' is a [[skill]] or [[buff]] that applies one or more [[effect]]s on [[nearby]] [[allies]] and/or [[enemies]] within the aura's [[area of effect]]. This mechanic can be found on a variety of [[skill]]s as well as [[NPC]]s and enemies. ==Mechanics== Being a subset of buff/debuff system, auras inherit all characteristics from them and are affected by buff modifiers. They can be temporary or permanent, positive or negative, and so on. Auras can only update their affected targets every 250ms. Auras which affect friendly units will affect the user and their [[allies]] within the aura's radius. Both the user and allies benefit from {{c|mod|#% increased Effect of Non-Curse Auras from your Skills}}, but only the user benefits from {{c|mod|Auras from your Skills have #% increased Effect on you}}. Skill tooltips only show the base aura stats and do not reflect any increases to aura effect. There is no limit to the number of auras a user can have. However, a player cannot have multiple copies of the same aura active. If a unit is being affected by multiple sources of the same aura, the strongest aura will apply. Aura effects which come from a passive skill or item modifier will not be affected by modifiers to aura skills, as they do not come from a skill. Note that passives/items that grant an aura ''skill'' are affected. ===Reservation=== {{main|Reservation}} Most aura skills [[Reservation|reserve]] a percentage or flat amount of your maximum [[mana]] (or [[life]]) to maintain their effects. Reservation sets aside a portion of a resource as unusable for as long as the aura is active. Reservation does not reduce the rate of regeneration or recovery. Reservation values are multiplied by [[support gem]] cost multipliers. The {{psl|Blood Magic}} [[keystone]] and {{il|Arrogance Support}} cause auras to reserve life instead of mana. [[Cost]] modifiers do not affect reservation amount, unless supported by [[Divine Blessing Support]], which replaces the aura's reservation amount into a skill cost. ==Sources of auras== Auras and aura-like effects can be found in a variety of different sources: * [[Skill gem]]s * [[Passive skill]]s * [[Monster modifiers]] and skills * [[Status ailment#Proliferation|elemental proliferation]] * [[unique item skill|Item skills]], such as {{il|Death's Oath}}'s {{sl|Death Aura}} * Modifiers from [[unique item]]s, such as {{il|Dying Breath}} * Other item modifiers, such as [[influenced item|influence]] helmet -#% resistance modifiers ===Curse auras=== {{see also|Curse}} With the use of the {{il|Blasphemy Support}} gem, any [[hex]] [[curse]] can be converted into an aura, reserving mana to create an area of effect around the player. Enemies who enter the Blasphemy aura are then cursed with the supported curse skill(s). Blasphemy auras are affected by both Curse and Aura Area of Effect increases. Most aura effect modifiers specify that they only apply to non-curse auras, so they will have no effect on Blasphemy. {{c|mod|#% increased Effect of your Curse}} will work, however. Curses applied via Blasphemy count toward the active [[curse limit]]. Curse auras also take priority over curses applied via casting, and will override those curses if they exceed the curse limit. ===Banners=== {{Main|Banner}} Banners are a sub-group of aura skills. While you don't have a banner placed, you gain Valour from melee combat. Using the banner skill consumes all stored Valour and places down the banner at your current location, which provide an aura effect around it for a duration or until you leave its radius or cancel it by using the skill again while the banner is placed. The banners gains increased aura effect and radius the more Valour was spent to place it. You cannot gain Valour while a banner is placed. {{il|Perfidy}} and {{psl|Worthy Causes}} removes this restriction. ===Mines=== Most [[mine]] skills and skills supported by {{il|High-Impact Mine Support}} create a debuffing aura effect around the mine. Auras from multiple mines stack. Auras from mines are affected by aura effect modifiers. ===Notable interactions=== *{{il|Spell Totem Support}} - Summons a [[totem]] that uses the aura. The base cost to summon the totem is equal to the aura's reservation amount. *[[Blessing skill]]s allows the user to have up to one aura with no reservation cost, with some caveats: **{{il|Eternal Blessing Support}} - Turns an aura into a permanently active Blessing, but prevents the user from reserving mana. **{{il|Guardian's Blessing Support}} - Turns an aura into a Blessing that's active while the supported minion is alive, but the minion takes physical damage over time. **[[Divine Blessing Support]] - Turns an aura into a temporary Blessing effect, causing it to have a skill cost instead of reservation. Only available from {{il|March of the Legion}}. ==Aura Skills== ===Aura skill gems=== Regular auras come from aura skill gems and [[mana reservation|reserve]] a percentage of the player's [[mana]] pool, with the exception of {{il|Clarity}}, {{il|Vitality}} and {{il|Precision}}, which reserve a flat amount. {{Drop enabled gem table |tables = skill |join = skill._pageID=skill._pageID |where = items.class_id="Active Skill Gem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Aura" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS NOT "Vaal" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS NOT "Totem" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS NOT "Attack" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS NOT "Mine" AND skill.active_skill_name NOT LIKE "%Banner%" |level=yes |int=yes |dex=yes |str=yes |skill_icon=yes |description=yes |mana=yes |large=yes }} ===Banner skill Using the {{il|Blasphemy}} gem linked to Hex gems, or socketing Hex gems into {{il|Heretic's Veil}} will allow those curses to be cast as auras. ===Auras skills granted by items=== *
